Official page verified live at https://www.aalto.fi/en/admission-services/scholarships-and-tuition-fees. Aalto University Excellence Scholarship is an institution-wide, admission-stage tuition fee waiver: 'In the master's admissions scholarships are allocated during the academic evaluation stage as part of the admissions process of a degree programme' and 'Scholarships can be awarded to the best applicants based on the programme's evaluation criteria... Applicants are ranked according to the criteria indicated on the programme's webpage.' No person is named on the scholarship page as a decision-maker, supervisor or faculty contact; published contacts are administrative only (admissions@aalto.fi, tuitionfees@aalto.fi). The named individual scholarship on the same page (Pekka Mattila Excellence Scholarship) is a donor-dedicated award for Marketing/International Management applicants, not a supervision role. Because the waiver applies across all English-taught bachelor's/master's programmes, no specific supervising professor can be evidenced.

Official page verified live at https://www.helsinki.fi/en/admissions-and-education/apply-bachelors-and-masters-programmes/tuition-fees-and-scholarship-programme. The scholarship programme is a university-level 50%/100% tuition fee waiver for master's applicants, applied for with the same application form as the degree programme and awarded with the admission result. No named professor, programme director or faculty supervisor is published on the scholarship page or linked admissions pages; contacts given are central Admission Services. No supervision tie exists in this scheme, so no professor entry can be evidenced.
